lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance spots are arranged in multiple vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank. Spot spacing is relatively uniform vertically, while horizontal distances between columns vary, creating a semi-regular 2D grid of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the spots, particularly in the mid-section, where spots appear as anchor nodes within a grid-like framework of vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges run horizontally along the flank. The most prominent ridge in the upper third shows a distinct vertical intensity gradient, with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow-induced low-luminance zone on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two distinct remoras attached to the ventral region, appearing as elongated, low-contrast silhouettes against the water column.
